n-ttc.text: Asked for by the owner: all current delays, the next bus, elevator and escalator outages, subway delays. It reads the transit agency's public feeds only. It sends nothing about the home: just which stops and routes to ask about. Every number shows how old it is, and a feed that stops answering says so instead of showing stale times as if they were live.
